mechanismAssessment.status: implemented; focused checks authored; root build and verification pending
mechanismAssessment.firstUse: A scalar fact records every actual own-turn declared effective Slash/FireSlash/ThunderSlash/Duel, whether declined, multi-target or sourced by a supported native virtual card. The first combined ordinal is not a skill usage debit; a later grant cannot recycle it. A repeated effect under the same use declares no new action and adds no first-use slot.
mechanismAssessment.target: Rechecks the actual owning frame's sole living target at the lowest finalized priority after earlier additions; never uses a stale original target-count snapshot.
mechanismAssessment.privacy: The exact effective Diamond Hand count is frozen only in trusted pending resolution state after activation. Both choices use X labels with no hidden identities or count. No issued public fact exposes X until the effect is selected. AI choices consult own hand count and a public prior, never the stored opponent suit count.
mechanismAssessment.draw: Actual DrawPile-to-owner-Hand movements have a typed instruction/source/window/use/action receipt and exact movement interval. Real observer children drain once through skill loss and owner death without repayment.
mechanismAssessment.damage: The original CardUseFrame stores a scalar damage bonus validated against issued scalar facts. Every original native non-chain Slash/Duel damage attempt, including reversed Duel damage, receives that bonus before normal damage caps. Issued bonuses survive source loss. Existing native elemental propagation carries the finalized damage without adding the same bonus again.
mechanismAssessment.verificationScope: Real serialized commands, fixed small seed/deck, genuine native frames and actual GameReplay.Restore engines continued at paused choices/children. No injected frames or seed searches. Root alone runs checks.

interpretationLimits: Current ordinary OL says 指定一个目标 rather than 每个目标. This implementation interprets it as a single final target at offer time, not one benefit per target. No current same-version primary combo FAQ was found for Fengpo combined with newly appended target mechanics.

回合内 is interpreted as the skill owner's actual turn. Declining the first combined Slash/Duel cannot transfer the opportunity to the other card kind. Current OL text is used; Ten Year separate first-Slash/first-Duel FAQ is excluded.

A benefit legitimately issued during a finalized window is not revoked solely because a later child changes targets. Priority ordering makes new built-in target additions precede this offer; all possible historical target-changing combinations are not claimed as live tested.

The existing legacy Action-null producer may occupy the declaration ledger, but is not given a fabricated Action or new generic finalized window. The representative virtual behavior check uses the genuine supported native zero-entity full action window.
Focused tests do not establish every elemental chain, armor, delayed draw or foreground desktop combination; existing native boundaries are retained.
temporaryFiles: No temporary directory created. Raw upstream bundles decoded in memory. Source/evidence/portrait/checks are retained deliverables; historical policy-blocked outputs were not deleted or retried.
